name: HIP 109427

planets.name: B
planets.note: Low-mass stellar companion (M4-M5.5, Teff ~3000-3200 K) at ~0.2" (~6 au) projected separation; semimajor axis 6.55(+3.0/-0.48) au, dynamical mass 0.280(+0.18/-0.059) Msun. Discovered via Stochastic Speckle Discrimination with SCExAO/MEC and confirmed with CHARIS spectroscopy and Keck/NIRC2 Lp photometry.

paper.title: SCExAO/MEC and CHARIS Discovery of a Low Mass, 6 AU-Separation Companion to HIP 109427 using Stochastic Speckle Discrimination and High-Contrast Spectroscopy

notes: HIP 109427 (theta Peg) is a nearby A1V lambda Boo star. Companion B was first detected with SCExAO/MEC using Stochastic Speckle Discrimination (SSD; Fig. 1 of the paper) and subsequently confirmed/characterized with SCExAO/CHARIS spectroscopy and Keck/NIRC2 Lp photometry (Fig. 2, used here). Tagged with method imaging per atlas convention; companion is low-mass stellar (M dwarf), not planetary, per the paper's own mass estimate.
